items.exampleEn: We shared a big bag of popcorn during the movie.
items.exampleZh: 看電影時我們分著吃一大包爆米花。

items.exampleEn: My sister is vegetarian, so she never eats meat.
items.exampleZh: 我姊姊吃素，所以她從不吃肉。

items.exampleEn: Please put the empty milk carton in the blue bin.
items.exampleZh: 請把空牛奶盒放進藍色的垃圾桶。
items.glossZh: 紙盒；（牛奶等的）盒裝容器

items.exampleEn: The baker gets up at four to make bread.
items.exampleZh: 麵包師傅四點起床做麵包。

items.exampleEn: This apple has a sweet taste.
items.exampleZh: 這顆蘋果有甜甜的味道。

items.exampleEn: This fruit drink contains no alcohol.
items.exampleZh: 這種果汁飲料不含酒精。

items.exampleEn: The farmer collects rain in a large barrel.
items.exampleZh: 那位農夫用一個大桶子收集雨水。

items.exampleEn: The kids made a mess in the kitchen.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們把廚房弄得一團亂。

items.sentenceEn: My uncle worked as a baker for twenty years.
items.sentenceZh: 我叔叔當了二十年的麵包師傅。

items.audioEn: Sorry about the mess. We are painting the office this week, so please use the meeting room.
items.audioZh: 抱歉這裡很亂。我們這週在油漆辦公室，所以請使用會議室。
items.questionZh: 辦公室這週為什麼很亂？

items.sentenceEn: Can you taste the garlic in this soup?
items.sentenceZh: 你吃得出這碗湯裡有大蒜嗎？

items.sentenceEn: The restaurant has a vegetarian menu with many choices.
items.sentenceZh: 這家餐廳有一份選擇很多的素食菜單。

items.stemEn: Could you buy a ____ of orange juice on your way home?
items.stemZh: 你回家的路上可以買一盒柳橙汁嗎？

items.stemEn: You must be eighteen to buy ____ in this shop.
items.stemZh: 在這家店要滿十八歲才能買酒。

items.passageEn: Last summer, a cinema hired Leo for a part-time job. Every evening, he made popcorn and sold drinks in small cartons. Some customers asked for vegetarian snacks, so the manager added cheese rolls from a local baker. Leo liked their taste, but he often ate too many. At the end of each night, he had to clean up the mess under the seats. The work was tiring, but he enjoyed it.
items.passageZh: 去年夏天，一家電影院雇用 Leo 做兼職工作。每天晚上，他做爆米花，賣小紙盒裝的飲料。有些客人想要素食點心，所以經理加賣了一位當地麵包師傅做的起司捲。Leo 喜歡起司捲的味道，但他常常吃太多。每天晚上收工時，他得清理座位底下的髒亂。這份工作很累人，但他做得很開心。

questions.questionZh: 經理為什麼加賣起司捲？
options: 有些客人想要素食點心
因為起司捲成本比較低

questions.questionZh: 每天晚上收工時，Leo 要做什麼？

items.promptZh: 那個大木桶裡裝滿了馬鈴薯。
referenceEn: The big wooden barrel is full of potatoes.
That large wooden barrel is filled with potatoes.
rubricZh: 「裝滿了」可寫，例如 is full of、is filled with 等
時態配合內容（多用現在簡單式）

items.instructionZh: 用 taste 造一個句子，描述一種食物或飲料的味道。
referenceEn: I love the taste of fresh strawberries.
This milk tastes a bit strange today.
rubricZh: taste 可當名詞（例如 the taste of…）、動詞（例如 tastes＋形容詞）等
動詞用法主詞第三人稱單數用 tastes
時態配合內容（多用現在簡單式）
